thread_text:
Priya (Partner Eng): Heads up - MedixOne SI hit a blocker on GCP Marketplace integration. Their deployment fails the entitlement check: IAM test returns 403 for the service account when invoking the onboarding webhook. Anyone familiar with GCP SaaS onboarding quirks?

Liam (Cloud Ops): Common causes: service account lacking the `iam.serviceAccounts.actAs` permission or the service account not being added to the right project/organization role. Do we have the error payload?

Priya (Partner Eng): Paste from their logs (sanitized): 
`POST /onboard HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden - caller: serviceAccount:si-onboard@medixone-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com - reason: PERMISSION_DENIED`

Noah (Solutions): Check if the onboarding webhook expects the request from the marketplace broker identity rather than the SI service account. Also verify the service account is present in the same project where the marketplace connector runs; cross-project service account usage needs explicit IAM binding.

Aisha (SI Lead): We created the SA in their control project and granted Editor on the connector project. Could the organization policy block cross-project SA usage?

Liam (Cloud Ops): Yes, org policy `constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation` or `constraints/iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains` can surface odd errors. Also ensure the SA has the `roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser` if they use Workload Identity federation.

Priya (Partner Eng): They also asked whether Redwood needs to approve any JSON manifest for GCP Marketplace. For AWS/Azure we sign off on connectivity — what about GCP?

Noah (Solutions): We do a short architecture review for GCP Marketplace SaaS offers: service account scopes, webhook auth, endpoints, and audit logging. I can draft the checklist. Liam, can you validate org policy pitfalls?

Liam (Cloud Ops): Yep. I'll create a small troubleshooting doc: 1) confirm SA has `iam.serviceAccounts.actAs` on connector project, 2) check org policies that block cross-project SA use, 3) verify webhook accepts the broker identity or SA token, 4) confirm Cloud Audit Logs are enabled for IAM and Admin Activity.

Aisha (SI Lead): I'll attach the service account IAM policy and the marketplace onboarding request logs to ticket RD-5132. Can you also confirm the expected broker identity ARN/email we ask partners to whitelist?

Priya (Partner Eng): Use `marketplace-broker@redwood-inference-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` for the broker. We'll also need them to allow the broker as an invoker on the Cloud Function if their webhook is a function.

Noah (Solutions): Action items: Aisha to upload policies/logs to RD-5132, Liam to produce org-policy checklist, Noah to draft GCP marketplace review template (ETA EOD), Priya to schedule a 30m review once artifacts are in.

Priya (Partner Eng): Thanks team. I'll post the invite and keep this thread updated.
